meta.description: Fully synthetic multi-thread fixture for the bulletin eval. A fictional team builds a fictional app ('Aurora'). No real memory content, names, or infrastructure.

messages.text: The staging deploy failed twice this morning with a checksum mismatch on the asset bundle.
Root cause: the CDN cache was serving a stale bundle manifest. Added a cache-bust header and a post-deploy verification step that compares the manifest checksum.
Verification step caught a bad deploy on the first try today. Keep it.
Users report PNG uploads over 4MB fail silently in Aurora.
Reproduced. The EXIF-stripping pass runs out of buffer on large PNGs and swallows the error. Fix drafted: stream the EXIF strip and surface upload errors to the UI. Awaiting review.
We need to pick a billing provider for Aurora subscriptions this week.
Comparison done. Decision: go with Lemonpay because of its usage-based invoicing API and EU tax handling. Integration spike scheduled for next week.
Aurora v1.4 shipped to production this evening: dark mode, the new export dialog, and the Finnish translation. Rollout is at 100% with error rates flat.
Design review for the new onboarding flow is booked for Friday. The prototype swaps the six-step wizard for a two-step checklist.
Noted. I will prepare the funnel numbers comparing wizard completion against the checklist prototype for the review.
Partners hit 429s overnight on the sync API.
Incident resolved: a partner retry loop amplified traffic 40x. Added per-key burst budgets and an alert. No action items remain open.
The API docs rewrite is drafted but stalled waiting on the new auth examples.
Offsite is confirmed for the second week of September in Lisbon. Need to book the workshop room by end of this month.
The analytics dashboard takes nine seconds to load for large workspaces since the v1.4 release. Started profiling this morning; the chart aggregation query looks like the suspect.
The legacy CSV importer was retired in June. Its replacement uses the bulk ingest endpoint with a Vermillion-format mapping file.

oracleBulletin:
RECENT ACTIVITY DIGEST (as of Fri 2026-07-17 morning)

In progress:
- PNG upload bug (active, yesterday): uploads over 4MB fail silently; root cause is the EXIF-stripping pass running out of buffer and swallowing the error. Fix drafted (streamed EXIF strip + surfaced errors), awaiting review.
- Dashboard performance (active, this morning): analytics dashboard loads in ~9s for large workspaces since v1.4; profiling started, chart aggregation query is the suspect.
- Onboarding redesign (active): design review booked for Friday; prototype replaces the six-step wizard with a two-step checklist; funnel numbers being prepared.
- Team offsite (active): confirmed for the second week of September in Lisbon; workshop room must be booked by end of month.

Recently shipped / decided:
- Aurora v1.4 shipped yesterday evening: dark mode, new export dialog, Finnish translation; rollout 100%, error rates flat.
- Billing decision (Wed): going with Lemonpay for usage-based invoicing and EU tax handling; integration spike next week.
- Deploy pipeline (Wed-Thu): staging failures traced to a stale CDN bundle manifest; cache-bust header plus post-deploy checksum verification added, already caught one bad deploy.

Quiet / resolved:
- API rate-limit incident (Mon): resolved; partner retry loop amplified traffic 40x; per-key burst budgets and alerting added, nothing open.
- Docs rewrite: stalled waiting on new auth examples.
